In the event the employee resigns or separates from the company prior to full recovery of the advance, the outstanding balance shall be deducted from the employee's full and final settlement without requiring additional consent. Should the full and final settlement amount be insufficient to cover the outstanding advance, the employee shall be obligated to repay the remaining balance via NEFT transfer within seven days of receiving the full and final settlement statement.
All advance salary transactions shall be documented and maintained in the payroll system to ensure transparency and auditability. Compliance with this policy is mandatory, and any deviations or violations shall be subject to review and appropriate action by the Human Resources and Finance departments.

parents.title: Payroll Policy
parents.breadcrumb: Payroll Policy > Salary Revision and Increment Processing Guidelines
parents.text:
## Salary Revision and Increment Processing Guidelines
Salary revisions and increments at Turabit Solutions Private Limited follow a structured annual cycle commencing on 1st April each year. Eligibility criteria include a minimum of six months confirmed service as of 31st March, a performance rating of 3 or higher in the October appraisal, and absence of any active disciplinary actions on the revision date. Increment percentages are aligned with performance ratings: exceptional (rating 5) receive 20 to 25%, exceeds expectations (rating 4) receive 12 to 18%, meets expectations (rating 3) receive 6 to 10%, while ratings below 3 receive no increment, with mandatory performance improvement plans for rating 1. Increment letters are issued by 30th April, with revised salaries effective from 1st April and arrears for April paid in May payroll. Off-cycle salary revisions are permitted for promotions, CEO-approved counter-offers, and HR-flagged market corrections, requiring CFO and CEO approval, effective from the first day of the month following approval. Department heads must submit increment recommendations to HR by 31st March using the standardized proposal form. HR reviews submissions for internal equity before forwarding to Finance and CEO for final approval. The payroll team updates revised salaries in Keka upon receipt of signed increment letters.

parents.title: Payroll Policy
parents.breadcrumb: Payroll Policy > Full and Final Settlement Calculation and Timeline
parents.text:
## Full and Final Settlement Calculation and Timeline
The Full and Final (FnF) settlement process at Turabit Solutions Private Limited is designed to ensure a comprehensive and timely closure of all financial obligations between the company and the employee upon separation, whether by resignation, termination, retirement, or contract completion. The FnF settlement is processed in strict adherence to the company's payroll policy and applicable Indian labour laws, maintaining transparency and accuracy.
Upon an employee's last working day, the FnF statement is prepared and issued within 30 calendar days. This statement details all payable components and applicable deductions, providing the employee with a clear overview of the final amount due. The payment of the FnF amount is credited to the employee's registered bank account within 45 calendar days from the last working day, subject to completion of all requisite formalities.
The FnF calculation includes several key components. Pending salary is calculated on a per-day basis for the final month worked, using a divisor of 26 days to determine the daily gross salary. Earned leave encashment is computed for all accumulated earned leave balances up to a maximum cap of 24 days, calculated as basic salary divided by 26, multiplied by the number of eligible leave days. Gratuity is payable if the employee's continuous service exceeds five years, calculated as fifteen days' wages per completed year of service, using the last drawn basic salary as the wage basis. Variable pay is pro-rated for the quarter up to the last working day, contingent on the employee meeting KPI targets and company revenue benchmarks. Additionally, any approved pending expense reimbursements and vested retention bonuses are included in the FnF amount.
Deductions from the FnF settlement are applied as per policy and statutory requirements. These include any outstanding salary advances, which are recovered in full; salary in lieu of notice period if the employee has not served or has short-served the notice; applicable Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) calculated on all FnF components in accordance with the Income Tax Act; and the value of any unreturned company assets such as laptops or access cards, as recorded in the asset register. Other dues owed to the company are also deducted accordingly.
The release of the FnF settlement is contingent upon the employee fulfilling all exit formalities. This includes the return of all company property verified by the IT department, completion of the exit interview, sign-off on knowledge transfer by the reporting manager, and clearance of no-dues certificates from IT, Administration, and Finance departments. Once the FnF statement is prepared, it is sent to the employee's personal email for review. The employee is granted five working days to raise any disputes or clarifications regarding the statement. Following resolution of any disputes, the Finance team processes the final payment via NEFT to the employee's registered bank account.
This structured FnF process ensures that all financial settlements are handled with due diligence, accuracy, and compliance, thereby safeguarding the interests of both the employee and Turabit Solutions.

parents.title: Payroll Policy
parents.breadcrumb: Payroll Policy > Payroll Dispute Escalation and Resolution Process
parents.text:
## Payroll Dispute Escalation and Resolution Process
Employees who identify discrepancies or concerns related to their payroll must follow a structured escalation and resolution process to ensure timely and accurate correction of any errors. The initial step requires employees to conduct a self-service review by carefully examining their payslip available on Keka HRMS. They should cross-reference the payslip details with their offer letter, increment letter, approved leave records, and any other relevant documentation before initiating a dispute. This preliminary verification helps clarify common misunderstandings and reduces unnecessary escalations.
If discrepancies persist after this review, the employee should submit a formal query by emailing payroll@turabitsolutions.com. The email must include the employee ID, the specific payroll month in question, and a detailed description of the issue, supported by relevant documents such as approved leave records, reimbursement approvals, or increment letters. The payroll team commits to responding within three working days, providing clarification or initiating corrective action as necessary.
Should the employee find the response unsatisfactory or if the issue remains unresolved after three working days, the matter should be escalated to the Human Resources Manager by contacting hrmanager@turabitsolutions.com. The HR Manager will review the case within two working days and collaborate with the Finance department to facilitate resolution. This step ensures that more complex or sensitive payroll issues receive appropriate managerial attention.
For disputes involving amounts exceeding Rs 10,000 or those unresolved after HR Manager intervention, escalation to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is required. The CFO will conduct a thorough review within three working days to determine the appropriate course of action. This hierarchical escalation framework guarantees that significant payroll discrepancies receive executive-level oversight.
Once a payroll error is confirmed through this process, corrections are typically implemented in the subsequent payroll cycle to ensure accurate salary disbursement. In cases where the error amount exceeds Rs 5,000, the CFO may authorize an off-cycle payment to expedite reimbursement, which will be processed within five working days of error confirmation. All identified errors and their resolutions are meticulously documented in the payroll audit log to maintain transparency and accountability.
Throughout the dispute resolution process, employees will receive written communication via email detailing the outcome and any corrective measures taken. This structured approach reinforces Turabit Solutions' commitment to maintaining a transparent, consistent, and compliant payroll system, thereby fostering employee trust and satisfaction.

parents.title: Payroll Policy
parents.breadcrumb: Payroll Policy > Policy Compliance, Audit Trail and Approval Authority
parents.text:
## Policy Compliance, Audit Trail and Approval Authority
All payroll activities at Turabit solutions must comply with this policy, applicable labor laws, and tax regulations.
The payroll department shall maintain a comprehensive audit trail of all payroll transactions, including salary calculations, deductions, payments, and approvals.
Regular internal audits shall be conducted to ensure adherence to policy and identify areas for improvement.
Any deviations or exceptions to the policy require documented justification and approval from the designated authority.
The Human Resources Manager holds the primary approval authority for payroll-related policies, salary advances, and revisions.
Senior Management approval is required for salary increments, structural changes, and final settlements.
Employees and managers must cooperate fully during audits and investigations related to payroll.
Non-compliance with this policy may result in disciplinary action, including corrective measures and potential legal consequences.
This policy shall be reviewed annually and updated as necessary to reflect changes in laws, business needs, or best practices.
All employees are responsible for understanding and adhering to the payroll policy to ensure smooth and transparent compensation management.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Purpose and Scope
parents.text:
## Purpose and Scope
The Code of Conduct at Turabit Solutions is designed to establish clear expectations for ethical behavior, professionalism, and compliance across the organization. Its purpose is to guide employees in making responsible decisions that align with the company's values, legal obligations, and industry standards within the SaaS ecosystem. This Code applies to all employees, contractors, consultants, and stakeholders associated with Turabit Solutions, regardless of role, seniority, or geographic location. It governs conduct in all work-related settings, including office environments, remote workspaces, client interactions, digital communications, and any situation where an individual represents the company. By adhering to this Code, all members of Turabit Solutions contribute to a culture of trust, respect, and excellence that supports the company's mission and reputation in the SaaS industry.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Core Values and Expected Professional Standards
parents.text:
## Core Values and Expected Professional Standards
Employees must consistently demonstrate integrity in all actions and decisions, ensuring honesty and ethical conduct at all times.
Employees shall be accountable for their responsibilities, delivering on commitments and accepting ownership of outcomes.
Transparency must be maintained in communications and reporting, fostering trust within teams and with clients.
Customer-centricity shall guide all work, prioritizing client needs and delivering high-quality solutions.
Employees must uphold high standards of professionalism, including respectful behavior, punctuality, and adherence to company policies.
Collaboration is essential; employees shall actively engage with colleagues, valuing diverse perspectives to drive innovation.
Innovation must be encouraged by embracing new ideas and continuous improvement in processes and products.
Compliance with all applicable laws, internal policies, and contractual obligations is mandatory for every employee.
Employees must act in the best interest of Turabit Solutions and its clients, avoiding conflicts and protecting company assets.
Honesty in all communications and decisions is required to maintain the company's reputation and ethical standing.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Respect, Inclusion and Anti-Discrimination Policy
parents.text:
## Respect, Inclusion and Anti-Discrimination Policy
Turabit Solutions is committed to maintaining a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination.
Employees must treat all colleagues, clients, and partners with dignity and respect, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.
Discriminatory behavior, exclusionary practices, or biased decision-making are strictly prohibited in all forms.
The company promotes equal opportunity in hiring, promotion, and all employment practices to ensure fairness and diversity.
Employees shall foster an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to contribute their ideas and talents.
Any incidents or concerns related to discrimination must be reported promptly through appropriate channels for investigation and resolution.
Managers and leaders are responsible for modeling inclusive behavior and addressing any violations of this policy swiftly and effectively.
Training and awareness programs will be provided regularly to reinforce the importance of respect and inclusion within the workplace.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Anti-Harassment and POSH Policy
parents.text:
## Anti-Harassment and POSH Policy
Turabit Solutions maintains a zero-tolerance approach toward harassment, including sexual harassment, in accordance with applicable laws such as the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) regulations.
Any unwelcome behavior--whether verbal, physical, or digital--that creates a hostile or intimidating work environment is strictly prohibited.
The company has established a formal Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) to address complaints confidentially, fairly, and promptly.
Employees are encouraged to report incidents of harassment without fear of retaliation or adverse consequences.
All complaints will be investigated with due sensitivity, impartiality, and in accordance with legal and company procedures.
Training on harassment prevention and awareness of POSH regulations will be provided regularly to all employees.
Managers must ensure a safe and respectful workplace and take immediate action if harassment is suspected or reported.
Confidentiality will be maintained throughout the complaint and investigation process to protect all parties involved.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Conflict of Interest Disclosure Requirements
parents.text:
## Conflict of Interest Disclosure Requirements
Employees must avoid situations where personal interests conflict, or appear to conflict, with the interests of Turabit Solutions.
Conflicts may include financial interests, external employment, personal relationships, or affiliations that could influence professional judgment.
Employees are required to disclose any actual or potential conflicts of interest promptly to their reporting manager or the HR department.
The company will review all disclosures and determine appropriate mitigation measures to ensure transparency and fairness.
Failure to disclose conflicts of interest may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.
Employees must recuse themselves from decision-making processes where a conflict of interest exists or could be perceived.
Regular training and reminders will be provided to help employees recognize and manage conflicts of interest effectively.
Open communication and honesty are essential to maintaining trust and integrity within the organization.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Gifts, Bribery and Anti-Corruption Guidelines
parents.text:
## Gifts, Bribery and Anti-Corruption Guidelines
Turabit Solutions enforces strict anti-corruption standards and complies with all applicable anti-bribery laws. Employees must not offer, solicit, or accept bribes, kickbacks, or any form of improper advantage. Gifts and hospitality may only be accepted if they are reasonable, infrequent, and do not influence business decisions. Any gift or benefit exceeding defined thresholds must be disclosed and approved in accordance with company policy. Ethical conduct in all business dealings is mandatory.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Social Media Usage and Public Communication Policy
parents.text:
## Social Media Usage and Public Communication Policy
Employees are expected to use social media responsibly and ensure that their public communications do not harm the reputation of Turabit Solutions.
Unauthorized sharing of confidential information, client data, or internal discussions is strictly prohibited.
When representing the company publicly, employees must ensure that communications are accurate, respectful, and aligned with official messaging.
Personal opinions expressed on social media must be clearly distinguished from the company's positions to avoid confusion.
Employees shall refrain from posting content that could be considered offensive, discriminatory, or damaging to the company's image.
Use of social media during working hours should not interfere with job responsibilities or productivity.
Any social media activity that raises concerns about compliance or ethics must be reported to management or HR.
Training and guidelines will be provided to help employees navigate social media use in a professional and compliant manner.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Data Privacy, Confidentiality and Cybersecurity Behavior
parents.text:
## Data Privacy, Confidentiality and Cybersecurity Behavior
Protecting data privacy and maintaining confidentiality are critical responsibilities at Turabit Solutions. Employees must handle company, client, and partner data with the highest level of care and comply with all data protection laws and internal security policies. Unauthorized access, sharing, or misuse of sensitive information is strictly prohibited. Employees must follow cybersecurity best practices, including secure password management, use of approved systems, and prompt reporting of any security incidents or breaches.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Responsible Use of Company Assets and Tools
parents.text:
## Responsible Use of Company Assets and Tools
Company assets, including hardware, software, networks, and intellectual property, must be used responsibly and solely for legitimate business purposes. Employees are expected to protect these resources from misuse, theft, or damage. Unauthorized installation of software, use of unapproved tools, or engagement in activities that compromise system security is not permitted. Responsible usage ensures operational efficiency and safeguards company resources. Employees should report any loss, damage, or security concerns related to company assets immediately to the appropriate department. Personal use of company assets should be limited and must not interfere with work duties or violate any company policies. Maintaining the integrity and security of company tools is essential to support Turabit Solutions' business operations and protect sensitive information. Regular audits and monitoring may be conducted to ensure compliance with these guidelines, and employees are expected to cooperate fully with such processes.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Attendance, Punctuality and Remote Work Accountability
parents.text:
## Attendance, Punctuality and Remote Work Accountability
Employees are expected to maintain consistent attendance, adhere to agreed working hours, and fulfill their responsibilities in a timely manner. Punctuality in meetings, deadlines, and deliverables is essential for effective collaboration and operational success. For remote work arrangements, employees must remain accessible during working hours, maintain productivity, and ensure clear communication with their teams. Accountability and discipline are critical to sustaining performance in a flexible work environment. Employees should notify their managers promptly in case of any absence or delay and follow established procedures for leave requests. Maintaining a professional approach to attendance and time management supports team cohesion and helps Turabit Solutions meet its business objectives efficiently.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Reporting Violations and Whistleblower Protection
parents.text:
## Reporting Violations and Whistleblower Protection
Turabit Solutions encourages employees to report any suspected violations of this Code of Conduct or other policies in good faith. Reports can be made through designated channels such as Human Resources, management, or anonymous reporting systems to ensure accessibility and confidentiality. The company is committed to protecting whistleblowers from retaliation and ensuring confidentiality throughout the investigation process. All reported concerns will be reviewed thoroughly and addressed appropriately with fairness and impartiality. Employees are assured that raising concerns in good faith will not result in adverse consequences. The company promotes a culture of openness and integrity by supporting those who come forward to uphold ethical standards and compliance.

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Consequences of Misconduct and Disciplinary Framework
parents.text:
## Consequences of Misconduct and Disciplinary Framework
Verbal or Written Warnings: For minor infractions or first-time violations, employees may receive verbal or written warnings outlining the issue and expectations for corrective action. This serves as an opportunity to improve behavior without formal penalties.
Suspension: More serious or repeated violations may result in temporary suspension from work duties, with or without pay, while investigations or corrective measures are undertaken. Suspension emphasizes the gravity of the misconduct and allows time for resolution.
Termination of Employment: Severe breaches of the Code of Conduct, including unethical behavior, legal violations, or actions damaging to the company's reputation, may lead to immediate termination of employment in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
Legal Action: In cases involving criminal conduct, fraud, or other unlawful activities, Turabit Solutions reserves the right to pursue legal action in addition to internal disciplinary measures to protect its interests and comply with legal obligations

parents.title: Code of Conduct
parents.breadcrumb: Code of Conduct > Employee Acknowledgement and Annual Re-Certification
parents.text:
## Employee Acknowledgement and Annual Re-Certification
All employees are required to formally acknowledge that they have read, understood, and agree to comply with the Code of Conduct at the time of onboarding. Additionally, employees must complete an annual re-certification process to reaffirm their commitment to these standards. Regular training and updates will be provided to ensure ongoing awareness and compliance. This acknowledgement serves as a formal agreement to uphold the ethical and professional expectations set forth by Turabit Solutions.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Parties Involved
parents.text:
## Parties Involved
This Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is entered into between Turabit solutions, a SaaS company headquartered in Pune, and the employee receiving confidential information. Turabit solutions is the Disclosing Party, and the employee is the Receiving Party. Both parties agree to the terms set forth herein to protect the confidentiality of proprietary and sensitive information shared during the course of employment.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Effective Date and Duration of Agreement
parents.text:
## Effective Date and Duration of Agreement
This Agreement shall become effective as of 05 May 2026 and shall remain in full force and effect throughout the term of the employee's engagement with Turabit solutions. The obligations of confidentiality shall survive the termination of employment and continue indefinitely with respect to all confidential information disclosed during the term of this Agreement.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Definition of Confidential Information
parents.text:
## Definition of Confidential Information
Confidential Information refers to any data or information, oral or written, disclosed by Turabit solutions to the employee that is not generally known to the public. This includes, but is not limited to, business strategies, technical data, software code, customer lists, pricing models, marketing plans, and any other proprietary information that provides Turabit solutions with a competitive advantage or is sensitive in nature.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Categories of Protected Information
parents.text:
## Categories of Protected Information
Business Information: This includes strategic plans, financial data, marketing strategies, sales forecasts, and internal reports that are critical to Turabit solutions' operations and competitive positioning. Such information is proprietary and must be safeguarded to maintain the company's market advantage.
Technical Information: Encompasses software source code, algorithms, system designs, product specifications, development methodologies, and technical documentation. This category protects the intellectual property and innovation that underpin Turabit solutions' SaaS offerings.
Customer and Client Data: Covers all personal and business information related to Turabit solutions' clients, including contact details, contract terms, usage data, and feedback. Protecting this data is essential to maintain client trust and comply with privacy regulations.
Employee and Organizational Information: Includes personnel records, compensation details, internal policies, organizational structures, and any other sensitive human resources data. This information is confidential to protect employee privacy and company integrity.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Scope and Purpose of Disclosure
parents.text:
## Scope and Purpose of Disclosure
The purpose of this Agreement is to ensure that all confidential information disclosed by Turabit solutions to the employee is used solely for legitimate business purposes related to the employee's role within the company. Disclosure of such information is strictly limited to activities necessary for the performance of assigned duties and responsibilities. The employee acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of confidential information could cause significant harm to Turabit solutions, including financial loss and damage to reputation. Therefore, the employee agrees to handle all confidential information with the highest degree of care and discretion. This Agreement governs all forms of disclosure, whether verbal, written, electronic, or otherwise, and applies to all confidential information shared during the course of employment. The employee shall not use the confidential information for any personal gain or for the benefit of any third party without prior written consent from Turabit solutions.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Obligations and Duties of the Receiving Party
parents.text:
## Obligations and Duties of the Receiving Party
6.1 The Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of all Confidential Information received from Turabit solutions and shall not disclose such information to any third party without prior written authorization.
6.2 The Receiving Party must use the Confidential Information solely for the purposes authorized under this Agreement and shall not use it for personal benefit or for the benefit of any other entity.
6.3 The Receiving Party shall take all reasonable measures to protect the confidentiality of the information, including implementing security protocols and restricting access to authorized personnel only.
6.4 The Receiving Party shall promptly notify Turabit solutions in writing upon discovery of any unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information or any other breach of this Agreement.
6.5 The Receiving Party shall not copy, reproduce, or otherwise duplicate Confidential Information except as necessary for authorized business purposes and shall ensure that all copies are marked as confidential.
6.6 The Receiving Party shall comply with all applicable laws and regulations relating to the protection of confidential and personal data.
6.7 Upon termination of employment or upon request by Turabit solutions, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all materials containing Confidential Information, including all copies, summaries, and extracts.
6.8 The Receiving Party shall ensure that any subcontractors, agents, or affiliates who have access to Confidential Information are bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained in this Agreement.
6.9 The Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble any software or technology disclosed as Confidential Information.
6.10 The Receiving Party acknowledges that any breach of these obligations may cause irreparable harm to Turabit solutions and agrees that Turabit solutions shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief in addition to any other remedies available at law or equity.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Permitted Disclosures and Exceptions
parents.text:
## Permitted Disclosures and Exceptions
This Agreement permits disclosure of Confidential Information only to individuals within Turabit solutions who have a legitimate need to know such information for business purposes. Any disclosure beyond this scope requires prior written consent from authorized representatives of Turabit solutions. Exceptions to confidentiality obligations include information that is publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party, information lawfully obtained from a third party without breach of confidentiality, or information independently developed without use of the Confidential Information. The undersigned parties hereby acknowledge and agree to the terms of this Agreement as of the dates indicated below.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Exclusions from Confidentiality
parents.text:
## Exclusions from Confidentiality
Confidential Information does not include information that is or becomes publicly known through no breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party, information that was lawfully in the Receiving Party's possession prior to disclosure by Turabit solutions, information independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to Turabit solutions' Confidential Information, or information disclosed pursuant to a legal obligation or court order, provided that the Receiving Party gives prompt notice to Turabit solutions to allow for protective measures.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Intellectual Property and Ownership Rights
parents.text:
## Intellectual Property and Ownership Rights
All Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement remains the sole property of Turabit solutions. The Receiving Party acknowledges that no license or ownership rights are granted by virtue of this Agreement except the limited right to use the Confidential Information strictly for authorized purposes. Any inventions, improvements, developments, or works created by the Receiving Party that incorporate or are derived from the Confidential Information shall be the exclusive property of Turabit solutions. The Receiving Party agrees to assign and hereby assigns all rights, title, and interest in such intellectual property to Turabit solutions. Furthermore, the Receiving Party shall cooperate fully with Turabit solutions in securing and enforcing intellectual property rights, including executing any necessary documents. This Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party any rights to use Turabit solutions' trademarks, service marks, or trade names without prior written consent. The Receiving Party shall not remove or alter any proprietary notices or labels on Confidential Information. The obligations under this section shall survive the termination of this Agreement and the employee's engagement with Turabit solutions indefinitely.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Return or Destruction of Confidential Information on Exit
parents.text:
## Return or Destruction of Confidential Information on Exit
Upon termination of employment or upon request by Turabit solutions, the Receiving Party shall promptly return all materials containing Confidential Information, including all copies, summaries, and electronic files. If requested, the Receiving Party shall certify in writing that all such materials have been returned or destroyed. The Receiving Party shall not retain any copies, extracts, or reproductions of Confidential Information after termination of employment.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Non-Solicitation of Clients and Employees
parents.text:
## Non-Solicitation of Clients and Employees
The Receiving Party agrees that during the term of employment and for a period of twelve months following termination, they shall not directly or indirectly solicit, induce, or attempt to solicit or induce any client, customer, or employee of Turabit solutions to terminate or alter their relationship with the company. This restriction applies to any business or entity that competes with Turabit solutions or could potentially harm its business interests. The Receiving Party acknowledges that this non-solicitation clause is reasonable and necessary to protect Turabit solutions' legitimate business interests, including its client relationships and workforce stability. Any breach of this provision shall entitle Turabit solutions to seek injunctive relief and any other remedies available under law or equity. This clause shall survive the termination of this Agreement and the employee's engagement with Turabit solutions.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Breach, Remedies and Injunctive Relief
parents.text:
## Breach, Remedies and Injunctive Relief
The Receiving Party acknowledges that any unauthorized disclosure or use of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm to Turabit solutions that cannot be adequately compensated by monetary damages alone. In the event of a breach or threatened breach of this Agreement, Turabit solutions shall be entitled to seek immediate injunctive relief, including temporary restraining orders and preliminary injunctions, without the necessity of posting bond or proving actual damages. Such remedies shall be in addition to any other legal or equitable remedies available, including claims for damages, specific performance, or termination of employment. The Receiving Party agrees to indemnify and hold Turabit solutions harmless from any losses, damages, or expenses arising from any breach of this Agreement. The failure to enforce any provision of this Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of any rights or remedies. This section shall survive the termination of this Agreement and the employee's engagement with Turabit solutions indefinitely.

parents.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
parents.breadcrumb: Non-Disclosure Agreement > Governing Law and Authorized Signatures
parents.text:

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the jurisdiction in which Turabit solutions is headquartered, without regard to its conflict of law principles. The undersigned parties represent that they have the authority to enter into this Agreement and agree to be bound by its terms. Signed on this 05 May 2026.

parents.title: Employment Contract
parents.breadcrumb: Employment Contract > Job Title, Role Description and Department
parents.text:
## Job Title, Role Description and Department
The employee shall be employed in the position of Software Engineer within the Engineering - Platform Team department. The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and APIs using Python and Django. Responsibilities include end-to-end delivery of assigned sprint tasks such as requirement analysis, implementation, unit testing, and code review. The employee will participate in system design discussions for new platform features, identify and resolve production issues within defined SLAs, write technical documentation, mentor junior engineers, collaborate with product managers and frontend engineers, and contribute to improving CI/CD pipelines and deployment reliability. Active participation in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives is also required.

parents.title: Employment Contract
